concepts.proposed_markdown: - [[source-adyen-docs-payment-methods-alipay-plus-web-drop-in]] — 2026-09-15 Alipay+ Web Drop-in Sessions (Checkout API v68+) and Advanced redirect add-on, with no stated test environment, live-request wording for “Alipay,” and a conflicting TEST-endpoint example.
warnings: The page says there is no Alipay+ test environment (raw lines 60,172), while its Advanced example calls checkout-test.adyen.com/v72/payments (line 108); do not infer a usable Alipay+ sandbox.
The live prerequisite says submit a request for Alipay before accepting live Alipay+ (raw lines 68,180); preserve this source wording without equating the methods or claiming approval.
Advanced table capitalizes Web/iOS/Android and conditionally requires browserInfo for Web (raw lines 102–103), while the sample uses lowercase channel web (line 121).
The Advanced Web Drop-in prerequisite URL contains unresolved encoded getParameter('platform') template text (raw line 78).
